source: Stylized mobile-game Meshy AI model supplied by the product owner (GitHub release modelle-3, stored as .cache/meshy3/jazeek_src.glb). Mesh shapes, UVs and texture content as delivered; game copy reduced by tools/meshy/reduce.py (120k triangles, base colour 4096 JPEG q88, normal map 2048, metal/roughness map dropped: the game renders the fighters cel shaded) and rigged by tools/meshy/skin.py. Generated trousers carried a third-party monogram print (GG); smoothed to plain fabric by tools/meshy/reduce.py RETOUCH (base colour + normal map).
license: Depends on the product owner's Meshy plan: free-plan generations are CC BY 4.0 (credit Meshy), paid plans grant ownership - verify before release
likeness: Depicts a real person at the product owner's request; name/likeness rights must be cleared before release
